01 / Selected work

One journey. A clearer direction.

Featured case study

UniPilot — Product experience redesign

Mobile experience · Interaction design · Visual system

The project

Studying abroad means navigating university choices, documents and deadlines. UniPilot brings those moving parts into one guided, personal journey.

The challenge

Make a complex process feel manageable.

The direction

A connected journey, not scattered checklists.

The experience

Personal goals, useful resources, clear next steps.

02 / A closer look

Clarity at every step.

03 / Design approach

Simple on the surface.
Considered underneath.

01

Give the journey structure

Break a big goal into meaningful stages, so the next step always feels within reach.

02

Make the important visible

Use hierarchy, contrast and focused actions to help people move with confidence.

03

Keep the experience connected

Bring navigation, tasks and resources together with one consistent visual language.
